content.descriptor: Korean skincare for professional programs and home use
about: TONEVER is a Korean skincare brand for professional programs and home use. According to the company, its approach draws on more than twenty years of practice at Tonup Aesthetic, specialist training and feedback from aesthetic treatment rooms.

The brand's philosophy centers on the skin's natural balance. The company connects this approach with natural cycles and attention to the foundations of skincare: selecting raw materials, gentle processing and comfortable formulas. Its materials identify three principles: stability, clean beauty and sustainability. These are stated development priorities, rather than product certifications.

TONEVER pays attention to ingredient origins, processing methods and application formats. Its professional programs use two-component systems: a freeze-dried ampoule mixed before application, and a two-ampoule routine applied in sequence. The home care line includes a foaming toner, ampoules, a barrier care cream and a finishing cream for a more even-looking tone.

For partners, the company describes professional skincare programs, training, application protocols and range development. Discussions about specific products, documents and supply are handled through Teranova. Formulas, labeling and permitted product claims are checked for the relevant market.

lines.name: THE PAMIN
lines.note: A professional system combining freeze-dried Black Signature with liquid Black Enhancer. The company describes it as intensive care for skin hydration, firmness and appearance. The catalog shows the dry component in a 500 mg vial and the liquid in a 7 ml vial; the presentation shows a set of three pairs of vials.

lines.name: LUMILOOK
lines.note: A two-step professional program with Signature and Highlighter ampoules. The presentation shows ten vials for the first step and ten for the second. The brand associates the line with care for radiance, a visibly even tone and skin firmness.

lines.name: REBELOOK
lines.note: A two-step ampoule program from the 2026 catalog. Gold Signature and Highlighter are presented as separate components. The company positions the program as care for the skin's appearance, radiance and even-looking tone.

lines.name: READY BOOSTER
lines.note: Repair Ready Toner De Rose Bubble Booster is a 200 ml foaming toner with a pump. It is intended as the first skincare step after cleansing. Its airy texture and rose water define the product; the company describes it as hydrating care that prepares the skin for subsequent products.

lines.name: AXIS AMPOULE
lines.note: A 100 ml ampoule product for home care. The presentation describes it as a multi-ingredient formula for skin that looks hydrated and well cared for. The bottle has a dropper.

lines.name: 72K FILM AMPOULE
lines.note: A 50 ml ampoule for home care. The brand describes a texture that leaves a moisturizing film and positions the product as care for dryness and the skin's appearance. The number 72K is part of the product name, rather than a promise about how long a result lasts.

lines.name: LUMENIQ CREAM
lines.note: A 100 ml home care cream in a tube. The presentation associates the line with barrier care, hydration and skin that looks well cared for. Its texture and format are intended for the cream step of a skincare routine.

lines.name: NUDE FIXER
lines.note: Tone-Up Finish Cream is a 30 ml finishing cream in a pump bottle. In the presentation, its purpose is associated with a visibly more even tone and a smoother, radiant-looking complexion. It is a cosmetic finishing step for skincare.

lines.name: AURORA SERUM
lines.note: In the Brand Proposal, AURORA SERUM is described as a hydrolyzed collagen serum for hydrating care. Centella leaf water, centella components and aloe leaf extract are also listed.
